Hi all,

Quick coordination note as we close Q2 check-ins. HR has asked us to provide a consolidated manager summary for exec review and a separate redacted pack they can share externally (prospect benchmarking, etc.). I propose the following minimal process so we keep things auditable and safe: 

- Each manager fills the attached manager_consolidation_template.docx with their notes, clear yes/no on promotion readiness, and one-line risk flags.
- Sensitive details (medical, investigation summaries) must NOT be in the shared doc; put those in the "HR only" box in the template.
- Upload the filled template to the linked Google Doc folder (see link below) and reply-all with your filename.
- Deadline: EOD Tuesday, 2027-06-08 (so People Ops can prepare the redacted pack).

For context: Ellen (People Ops) will assemble the redacted deck and circulate to leadership. If anything is urgent for escalation, mark the template flag and cc Irene so we can triage.

Attachments: manager_consolidation_template.docx (please use exactly this file).

Thanks — want a low-friction process, not a heavy doc exercise. Short answers, please.

—Sean
